name: Tongyi DeepResearch
description: Alibaba's open deep-research agent: an open-weights model plus a ReAct inference harness for long-horizon information seeking.
whatItDoes: It answers hard multi-step questions by searching, visiting pages, running code and reading files, and is mainly used by researchers to reproduce results or batch-run their own question sets.
howItWorks: A ReAct loop drives the Tongyi-DeepResearch model, served locally or through an API, with search, page visit, scholar, Python sandbox and file-parsing tools. A shell script launches inference over a dataset of questions.

requirements.name: API_KEY
requirements.description: OpenAI-compatible key used for page summarisation, with API_BASE
